## Current work (2025–present)

### Intercom — Senior Product Engineer on Fin
Building the Intercom Help Center Fin Agent integration. End-to-end product engineering across model integration, web surface, bug resolution, and performance.

### SnT Luxembourg — R&D Specialist (two research tracks)

**RTE Tommer — Common Crawl → Knowledge Graph pipeline**
- Apache Airflow orchestrating a four-DAG flow:
  1. Query the Common Crawl CDX index; filter and dedupe URLs
  2. Fetch WARC/WET content; extract clean text
  3. LLM extracts entity-relation triplets from each page
  4. ToMMeR NER (Llama-3.2-based, `llm2ner/ToMMeR-Llama-3.2-{1B,3B}_L3_R64`) runs on top, with Wikidata QID mapping
  5. Final stage (planned): ingest the graph into Neo4j
- Containerised end to end; ToMMeR runs as its own FastAPI microservice.
- Source data: Wikipedia subset of Common Crawl.

**CEBI Luxembourg — fully-local DFMEA Q&A assistant**
- Privacy-first Q&A over a CEBI Luxembourg DFMEA (Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) document for a FIAT temperature-sensor assembly.
- All inference local via Ollama; no cloud calls; confidential automotive data stays on the host.
- Multilingual: Mistral-Nemo (12B, IT/FR/EN); `nomic-embed-text` embeddings.
- Multi-modal retrieval: SQLite + FTS5 (structured + full-text) and ChromaDB (semantic).
- Streamlit chat UI with a query router that picks the right index per question.

## Convictions

> Most LLM apps fail not because the model is wrong, but because the retrieval is shallow, the graph is missing, and the evaluation is unspoken. I work on the boring parts that make the magic land.
